definition: [ עָשֵׁשׁ ] verb waste away (compare Assyrian ašašu , moth ; Arabic moth (-worm), eat (of moth; ? denominative); according to De Ps 6:8 and others עָשֵׁשׁ is denominative from עָשׁ , properly be moth-eaten , but improbable); ** according to Jacob ZMG 1901, 141; ZAW 1902, 107 be dark , compare עשׁשׁא darkness , in Christian-Palestinian Aramaic. — Qal Perfect 3 feminine singular עָֽשְׁשָׁה מִכַּעַם עֵינִי Ps 6:8 my eye is wasted from grief , = Ps 31:10 ( בְּכַעַס ; + נַפְשִׁי , בִּטְנִי ; 3 plural עֲצָמַי עָשֵׁ֫שׁוּ v Ps 31:11 .

BDB6465 [H6244]

BDB6464 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB6466

[עָשֵׁשׁ] verb waste away (compare Assyrian ašašu, moth; Arabic moth (-worm), eat (of moth; ? denominative); according to DePs 6:8 and others עָשֵׁשׁ is denominative from עָשׁ, properly be moth-eaten, but improbable);

**according to JacobZMG 1901, 141; ZAW 1902, 107 be dark, compare עשׁשׁא darkness, in Christian-Palestinian Aramaic. —
Qal Perfect 3 feminine singular עָֽשְׁשָׁה מִכַּעַם עֵינִי Ps 6:8 my eye is wasted from grief, = Ps 31:10 (בְּכַעַס; + נַפְשִׁי, בִּטְנִי; 3 plural עֲצָמַי עָשֵׁ֫שׁוּ vPs 31:11.
